name: Carrier boundary receiver loads and rejects SP without changing the saved ledger before and after reload

steps.code:
assert(not GameConfiguration.IsAnyMultiplayer(),'single-player regression required')
assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_CarrierBoundary,'boundary receiver failed to load')
assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_CARRIER_BOUNDARY_V1')==nil,'unexpected accepted receipt before probe')
local before=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_STATE_V1')
assert(before,'saved absorption ledger missing')
local R=assert(JAC_AbsorptionRules)
local snapshot=R.Copy(before)
GameEvents.JAC_CarrierBoundary_Operation.Call(0,{Version=1,Command='BOUNDARY'})
assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_CARRIER_BOUNDARY_V1')==nil,'single-player operation accepted a receipt')
assert(R.Equal(snapshot,Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_STATE_V1')),'rejected boundary changed saved carrier intent')
print('[JAC_CARRIER_BOUNDARY_SP_GUARD] rejected; saved ledger unchanged')
return 'boundary receiver loaded and single-player guard preserved saved intent'
